gap:logistic_model_fitting.statement: Need to fit logistic regression with specific conventions (full-batch GD, 200 iterations, lr=0.1, logit clipping [-30,30]) and evaluate L2 regularization, interaction terms, and model compression on cross-validated Brier score.

claim:part1_lambda_tuning.statement: Lambda=0.1 provides the lowest 5-fold cross-validated Brier score (0.207077) among [0.0, 0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 10.0], with an improvement of 0.00890 over baseline (lambda=0.0).

claim:part2_interactions.statement: Interaction features (x0*x1, x1*x2, x2*x3, x0*x3) significantly improve model performance with paired t-statistic of 3.912 (p < 0.05, t > 2.0 threshold), reducing mean Brier from 0.2071 to 0.1814 across 5 folds.

claim:part3_compression.statement: The sparsity20_bits4 configuration achieves the highest retention (0.9998) of dense-model Brier performance, maintaining 99.98% accuracy while reducing 20% of weights to zero and quantizing to 4 bits.
